qa.overall_assessment: The right sidebar infrastructure works on desktop: sidebar opens on tool content click, closes on X button and Escape key, shows tool name in header. However, two significant issues were found: (1) sidebar content is placeholder text only -- SidebarContentRenderer is not wired into RightSidebar.tsx, so all tool types show 'Tool Detail: <toolName>' instead of actual content; (2) mobile sidebar modal does not open -- clicking tool content on mobile viewport (390px) navigates to the detail page instead of opening a full-screen modal overlay.

all_findings.issue: SidebarContentRenderer not integrated into RightSidebar. The SidebarContent function renders placeholder text ('Tool Detail: <toolName>') instead of using the SidebarContentRenderer component that exists in components/sidebar/. All 5 sidebar content files (SidebarContentRenderer, SidebarAgentConversation, SidebarFileView, SidebarBashView, SidebarGenericView) are created but unused.
all_findings.recommendation: Import SidebarContentRenderer from '@/components/sidebar/SidebarContentRenderer' and replace the placeholder SidebarContent function. Pass the full tool data (tool, messages, metadata, sessionId) to SidebarContentRenderer.

all_findings.issue: Mobile sidebar modal does not open when clicking tool content on narrow viewport (390px). The click navigates to the detail page instead. This suggests the content click handler (onContentPress) either does not fire on mobile, or the event is intercepted by the existing navigation Pressable before reaching the content Pressable. The MobileSidebar component with RNModal exists in code but is never reached because the sidebar store never gets opened on mobile.
all_findings.recommendation: Debug the click event propagation in ToolView.tsx on mobile. The content area Pressable may be overlapped by the header Pressable or the parent navigation link. Ensure event.stopPropagation() is called in the content press handler to prevent navigation.

refined_context.recommended_approach: 1. In RightSidebar.tsx, import SidebarContentRenderer and replace the SidebarContent placeholder with it, passing tool data. 2. In ToolView.tsx, ensure the content area Pressable calls event.stopPropagation() to prevent the parent navigation Pressable from intercepting the click on mobile. 3. Verify both fixes on desktop (1280px) and mobile (390px) viewports.
refined_context.additional_context: The sidebar infrastructure (store, layout, close handlers, Escape key, session-change cleanup) all work correctly. The two issues are: wiring the content renderer and fixing mobile click routing.
